text:
Zoe P.: quick heads-up — small press visit at 15:00, four people. one of them is bringing a delicate vintage satchel (textile) that needs climate-controlled short-term storage. also a lunch drop of 4 boxes arriving ~14:45. can we do temp badges and two high stools by the demo table?
Eli (People Ops): noted. is the satchel coming via courier or someone's hand-carried? if courier, we need chain-of-custody and a sign-off. :memo:
DeliveryBot: Delivery scheduled: `VINTAGE_SATCHEL` for Zoe P. ETA 14:15 via UPS. Requires signature. Please upload any item manifest to `visitor-uploads/`.
Tom (Mailroom): mailroom can accept and hold delicate items in Climate Cabinet #2 for up to 4 hours. someone must come sign it out. we'll need a photo on file.
Zoe P.: courier delivery — i asked them to ring and leave with mailroom. guest list uploaded as `press_guests_2026.csv`. please use `visitor-lanyard-v4.pdf` for badges (pronouns included).
Frontdesk Bot: Guest list received. Badge template `visitor-lanyard-v4.pdf`. Badges can be printed on arrival; max temp badges per job: 10. Estimated print time: 2 mins.
Marta L.: i can bring 2 high stools and escort from lobby. also happy to take the lunch boxes to pantry B if fridge space is needed.
Eli (People Ops): quick seat/stool poll — react with :hand: if you can spare a stool at 14:50 for setup.
Tom (Mailroom): accepted satchel at 14:17. tagged as `SATCHEL-ZOE-3141592653` and uploaded photo to `mail-photos/3141592653.jpg`. satchel stored in Climate Cabinet #2.
DeliveryBot: Delivery alert: lunch drop `GreenFork_Press_4boxes` ETA 14:45. COI for external food vendor on file: `GreenFork_COI_20260320.pdf`.
Zoe P.: perfect. Marta 14:50 meet me by the front desk and i'll sign for the satchel before the guests arrive. can front desk please add a note on the badges: "press" under company? small request from PR.
Frontdesk Bot: Badges printed with `visitor-lanyard-v4.pdf` at 14:55. 4 badges ready in lobby tray. Note field `company: press` added.
Eli (People Ops): checklist for anyone joining later: 1) satchel accepted & in Climate Cabinet #2, 2) photo uploaded, 3) guest list uploaded, 4) badges printed `visitor-lanyard-v4.pdf`, 5) 2 stools reserved and escort assigned, 6) lunch drop accepted. ping if any changes.
Zoe P.: thanks team — see you at 15:00. :coffee:
